# Machine Learning

Machine learning is a field of artificial intelligence focused on building systems that learn from data.

## Subfields

Modern machine learning branches into [[Deep Learning]] and reinforcement learning.
Architectures rely heavily on [[Neural Networks#Architectures]].

## Theory

Core statistical foundations include linear algebra and Bayesian inference.
